name: MasterCraft Boat Holdings, Inc.
summary: MasterCraft Boat Holdings, Inc., through its subsidiaries, designs, manufactures, and markets recreational powerboats. It operates through Performance and Wake, Leisure, and Recreation and Sport Fishing segments. The Performance and Wake Segment manufactures and sells ski/wake boats used for water skiing, wakeboarding, wake surfing, and general recreational boating under the MasterCraft brand name. The Leisure segment manufactures and sells pontoon boats used for general recreational boating under the Crest and Balise brand names.
